record.body:
## Rationale

A host the user installed globally is still a host they use in a project. Detecting both scopes, and labeling whether the footprint is project, global, or both, lets a project install offer Claude or OpenCode without pretending the project already has a local config directory. The labels also explain why a host appears when its project directory does not exist yet.

## Counter-argument

Detecting only the selected scope is simpler and avoids false positives from unrelated global config directories. A global `~/.claude` can exist for a host the user does not want in this project. The explicit selection prompt and the `--list` output mitigate that by showing the source of each detection.
